rows.label: qst104501_msg0001
rows.name:
Sniff-sniff... You smell strong, mo!
Are you strong, mo?
You are strong, mo?

rows.label: qst104501_msg0002
rows.name:
Sorry, mo. It was rude of me to
sniff you all of a sudden, mo.

rows.label: qst104501_msg0003
rows.name:
Kukun has a very good nose, mo. My
nose has never failed me, mo.

rows.label: qst104501_msg0004
rows.name:
Kukun's nose told me to open a new
shop in Temperantia, mo!

rows.label: qst104501_msg0005
rows.name:
But since no one else has opened a
shop, I don't know a safe trade route,
mo.

rows.label: qst104501_msg0006
rows.name:
I decided it'd be too dangerous to
lead everyone safely relying only on
Kukun's nose, mo.

rows.label: qst104501_msg0007
rows.name:
So I was sniffing around for someone
strong who could help as a bodyguard,
mo.

rows.label: qst104501_msg0008
rows.name:
Out of the 100 people I sniffed,
you smelled the strongest, mo!

rows.label: qst104501_msg0009
rows.name:
Please, mo! I want you to help us
open our shop, mo.

rows.label: qst104501_msg0011
rows.name:
I'll be waiting at Overlook Hill in
Temperantia, so please come, mo!
